childrensMagicPage.title: Children's Magic
childrensMagicPage.subtitle: Magical entertainment that makes children dream and adults smile
childrensMagicPage.aboutText1: TrylleKenneth specializes in colorful and fun magic for children's birthdays, family events, schools and kindergartens. With over 20 years of experience, Kenneth creates magical moments for children of all ages.
childrensMagicPage.aboutText2: Each performance is tailored to the age group and event, with interactive magic that makes children part of the magic.
childrensMagicPage.interactiveText: The children are part of the magic and become part of the performance
childrensMagicPage.laughsText: Fun, humor and joy guaranteed for the whole audience
childrensMagicPage.memoryText: Magic that children and adults will talk about for years
childrensMagicPage.detailsText: From toddlers to teenagers - there is magic for everyone
childrensMagicPage.focusText: Kenneth knows how to keep children engaged and excited

standUpMagicPage.title: Stand-up Magic
standUpMagicPage.subtitle: Professional magic with humor, charm and respect for the audience
standUpMagicPage.aboutText1: TrylleKenneth's stand-up magic is perfect for corporate events, parties, team building and entertainment evenings. With over 20 years of experience, Kenneth combines technical skill with natural charisma.
standUpMagicPage.aboutText2: The performances are engaging, funny and never humiliating. The audience is amazed by Kenneth's technical skills and wit.
standUpMagicPage.professionalText: Over 20 years of experience with corporate and private events
standUpMagicPage.humorText: Funny magic that entertains both individuals and large audiences
standUpMagicPage.respectText: No one gets humiliated - only amazed and entertained
standUpMagicPage.adaptText: Perfect for restaurants, hotels, company events and private parties
standUpMagicPage.cardsText: Amazing card tricks that create astonishment and wonder
standUpMagicPage.coinsText: Coins appear, disappear and transform right in your hand
standUpMagicPage.objectsText: Magic with everyday objects that amazes the audience

closeUpMagicPage.title: Close-up Magic
closeUpMagicPage.subtitle: Magic with cards, coins and objects right in front of the audience
closeUpMagicPage.aboutText1: Close-up magic is perfect for creating intimate moments at larger events. Kenneth works with cards, coins, banknotes and everyday objects to create magical moments right in front of the audience.
closeUpMagicPage.aboutText2: The close contact creates a special connection between Kenneth and the audience, making every magic moment unforgettable.
closeUpMagicPage.cardsText: Amazing card tricks that create astonishment and wonder
closeUpMagicPage.coinsText: Coins appear, disappear and transform right in your hand
closeUpMagicPage.objectsText: Magic with everyday objects that amazes the audience
closeUpMagicPage.intimateText: Personal connection between magician and audience

santaPage.subtitle: Santa and magical entertainment for Christmas, Halloween, Fastelavn and special events
santaPage.aboutText1: Make your seasonal event unforgettable with Kenneth as Santa Claus or with magical seasonal entertainment. Perfect for Christmas parties, Halloween events, Fastelavn celebrations and other special occasions.
santaPage.aboutText2: Kenneth brings joy, magic and unforgettable memories to every seasonal celebration. Each performance is tailored to the occasion and audience.
santaPage.christmasText: Santa Claus and Christmas magic for the whole family
santaPage.halloweenText: Spooky and fun magic for Halloween celebrations
santaPage.fastelavnText: Fun magic and entertainment for Fastelavn festivities
santaPage.customText: Seasonal magic tailored to your specific occasion

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Common questions about TrylleKenneth's services
faqPage.bookingA1: You can contact Kenneth through the contact form on this website, call at 40 85 27 28, or email kenneth@tryllekenneth.dk.
faqPage.bookingQ2: How much notice do you need?
faqPage.bookingA2: Ideally 2-3 weeks notice, but we try to accommodate last-minute bookings when possible.
faqPage.pricingA1: Pricing depends on the type of performance, duration and location. Contact Kenneth for a custom quote.
faqPage.performanceA1: Performances typically last 30-60 minutes, but can be tailored to your needs.
faqPage.performanceQ2: Do you travel outside the area?
faqPage.performanceA2: Yes, Kenneth performs throughout Denmark and is happy to discuss travel arrangements.

contactPage.title: Contact TrylleKenneth
contactPage.subtitle: Get in touch to book your magical experience
contactPage.responseMessage: Thank you for your message! I will contact you soon.
contactPage.locationText: I can meet you throughout Denmark. My home base is Copenhagen, but I offer travel throughout the country.
contactPage.bookingTimeText: I recommend booking at least 2-4 weeks before your event. For large events, longer lead times may be necessary.
contactPage.needQuickResponseText: Contact me directly by phone for the quickest response.
contactPage.ctaText: I look forward to creating magical memories for your next event
